  • observed_ui_text: Policy clearly lists webform and phone methods for the Right to Access/Know.
  • action_taken: Scrolled to California section and extracted submission sentences.

2. Evidence #2
  • page_url: https://www.statsocial.com/datarequest
  • evidence_type: ui_behavior
  • raw_snippet: Please provide me with a list of categories of the personal information you have collected about me in the last 12 months.
Please provide me with the specific pieces of personal information you have collected about me in the last 12 months.
  • observed_ui_text: Form includes explicit options for categories and specific pieces, consistent with Right to Know/Access.
  • action_taken: Opened the DSAR form and reviewed available request-type checkboxes.
  • dynamic_outcome: Options align with policy-stated access rights.
ground_truth:
Found. See explanation below:

Instance 1 under: "11. Your Rights and Marketing Choices (and Notice of Your Right to Opt Out)"
````
The right to obtain a copy of Personal Information we have obtained about you in a portable and, to the extent technically feasible, readily usable format, which can be done on our website here (https://www.statsocial.com/datarequest/)
````

Instance 2 below the above heading ("Submitting Requests"):
```
Submitting Requests
If you are a resident of one of the above states you may submit any of the above requests by call us at 1 (800) 793-6855 or use the contact (https://www.statsocial.com/contact-us/) form available on our website. We will respond to your request in compliance with the requirements of your state’s applicable laws. Please note that we are only required to honor California requests to know twice in a 12-month period.
```

Hence, different links provided that navigate to different pages to exercise rights.

Also, no "Addendum" is mentioned and hyperlinked below as mentioned in the following:
```
(as to which a separate “Addendum” is provided below)
```
rationale: The Privacy Policy directs users to a DSAR webform and phone number for exercising access rights, and the DSAR form provides matching options for categories and specific pieces, indicating no contradiction between instruction and UI.
